edges.reason: msg.sender determines the balance key read and written inside StandardToken.transfer.
msg.sender indexes balances in the unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value.
msg.sender provides the spender dimension of the allowance check in transferFrom.
msg.sender participates in the allowance gating that precedes the unchecked balance subtraction.
msg.sender indexes allowed[_from][msg.sender] in the unchecked allowance subtraction.
msg.sender is the owner key written in allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
msg.sender receives the full initial supply, making the constructor sender-sensitive.
msg.sender is forwarded as an argument to the untrusted external call in approveAndCall.
StandardToken.transfer executes the unchecked credit balances[_to] += _value.
StandardToken.transfer executes the unchecked debit balances[msg.sender] -= _value.
StandardToken.transferFrom executes the unchecked credit balances[_to] += _value.
StandardToken.transferFrom executes the unchecked debit balances[_from] -= _value.
StandardToken.transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance decrement allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary _spender before completing, exposing reentrancy.
The callee invoked by _spender.call can call back into approveAndCall or other token functions reentrantly.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount.
Constructor assigns totalSupply = _initialAmount.
Constructor assigns name = _tokenName.
Constructor assigns decimals = _decimalUnits.
Constructor assigns symbol = _tokenSymbol.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the nested allowed mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the nested allowed mapping before calling out.

Parameter _to is the key credited in transferFrom's balances[_to] += _value.

Parameter _value is the unchecked subtrahend in transferFrom's balance debit.
Parameter _value is the unchecked subtrahend in the allowance decrement.
Parameter _owner selects the balance returned by balanceOf.
Parameter _spender is the key written in approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance stored in approve.
Parameter _owner selects the allowance owner in allowance().
Parameter _spender selects the allowance spender in allowance().
Parameter _initialAmount determines the minted supply and balances[msg.sender].
Parameter _tokenName is stored into the name state variable.
Parameter _decimalUnits is stored into the decimals state variable.
Parameter _tokenSymbol is stored into the symbol state variable.
Parameter _spender is the arbitrary callee address of the external call.
Parameter _value is forwarded to the external callee, allowing state-dependent reentry.
Parameter _extraData is attacker-controlled calldata passed to the external call.
